name: Meteors
description: A meteor-shower background of glowing streaks falling at a configurable angle, driven entirely by CSS keyframes with deterministic per-meteor positions and timing.
a11yNotes: The meteor layer is aria-hidden and pointer-events: none; foreground children keep their own semantics. Positions and timings come from a seeded rand(n) so SSR markup is stable. Under prefers-reduced-motion the animation is removed and meteors render as faint static streaks.

propsApi.name: count
propsApi.description: Number of meteors in the shower.

propsApi.name: speed
propsApi.description: Speed multiplier; each meteor's base fall time is 2-5s divided by this value.

propsApi.name: angle
propsApi.description: Travel direction in degrees, clockwise from pointing right (135 = down-left).

propsApi.name: meteorColor
propsApi.description: Color of the meteor head glow and trail.

propsApi.name: children
propsApi.description: Foreground content centered above the shower.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.
